title: AI × Chem 每日精选
subtitle: 预印本、方法、数据集与实验验证的每日精选。
method: 公开来源采集、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，依据频道主题与证据信号筛选候选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: A multi-agent molecular optimization framework leads to a rapid-recovery intravenous anesthetic candidate with an improved safety margin
items.abstract_or_text: Lead optimization, the systematic refinement of therapeutic compounds through iterative structural modification, faces a dual challenge in modern drug discovery: navigating astronomically vast molecular design spaces while balancing conflicting demands on potency, pharmacokinetics, and safety. We present MASCOT (Multi-Agent SearCh for molecular OpTimization), a role-specialized multi-agent framework for molecular optimization. Integrated with a chemically constrained graph-editing search, MASCOT coordinates three specialized agents: a trade-off agent that reprioritizes competing objectives, a strategy agent that adapts how molecular edits are proposed, and a reflection agent that distills lessons from previous decisions. Computational experiments showed that MASCOT achieved the best performance over competing methods on six benchmark settings. On the SARS-CoV-2 main protease task, its mean docking-score improvement was 3.6 times that of the strongest baseline. Applied to the clinically used anesthetic remimazolam (RM), MASCOT prioritized RM-1, which showed a shorter liver microsomal half-life, higher brain exposure, and a larger therapeutic index than RM. Subsequent derivative design yielded RM-7. Extensive animal studies established RM-7 as a rapid-recovery intravenous anesthetic candidate with greater potency, faster functional recovery, a wider safety margin, and preserved flumazenil reversibility. These results demonstrate that multi-agent coordination can link adaptive molecular search to medicinal chemistry and experimental pharmacology.
items.summary_zh: MASCOT 将化学约束图编辑搜索与三个职责专门化智能体结合，用于在效力、药代和安全性之间进行先导化合物优化。它在6项基准设置中表现最佳，并由 remimazolam 衍生物 RM-7 的动物研究给出实验延伸：该候选物显示出更高效力、更快功能恢复、更宽安全窗及保留的 flumazenil 可逆性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作把多智能体分子搜索推进到可检验的药理实验候选物，实验药效和安全性证据显著增强了其转化价值。需留意结果集中于一个麻醉剂优化系列，跨靶点、合成可行性及临床可重复性仍有待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 先导优化即通过迭代结构修饰系统性改良治疗化合物，在现代药物发现中面临双重挑战：既要在天文数字般庞大的分子设计空间中导航，又要平衡效力、药代动力学和安全性这些相互冲突的要求。我们提出 MASCOT（Multi-Agent SearCh for molecular OpTimization），一种用于分子优化的角色专门化多智能体框架。MASCOT 与化学约束图编辑搜索结合，协调三个专门智能体：重新排序竞争目标的权衡智能体、调整分子编辑提议方式的策略智能体，以及从既往决策中提炼经验的反思智能体。计算实验表明，MASCOT 在6项基准设置中取得了优于竞争方法的最佳表现。在 SARS-CoV-2 主蛋白酶任务中，其平均对接评分改善幅度为最强基线的3.6倍。应用于临床使用的麻醉剂 remimazolam（RM）时，MASCOT 优先选择了 RM-1；与 RM 相比，RM-1 具有更短的肝微粒体半衰期、更高的脑暴露和更大的治疗指数。随后进行的衍生物设计得到 RM-7。广泛的动物研究证实，RM-7 是一种快速恢复的静脉麻醉候选物，具有更高效力、更快的功能恢复、更宽的安全窗，并保留 flumazenil 可逆性。这些结果表明，多智能体协同可将自适应分子搜索与药物化学及实验药理学联系起来。

items.title: Monroe: A Molecular Foundation Model for In-Context Probabilistic Inference
items.abstract_or_text: Bioassay activity prediction is often data-limited because drug-discovery datasets rely on time-consuming and expensive wet-lab experiments for data generation and evaluation. This challenge has inspired recent research into molecular foundation models (MFMs), which aim to encode general-purpose chemical knowledge into molecular representations that generalize well in data-constrained scenarios. This paper presents Monroe, a new MFM with several innovations over the existing state of the art: increased scale allowing pre-training on over 81 million molecules from the PM6 quantum chemistry dataset; improved graph representation of stereochemistry; improved training losses including conformer denoising and embedding decorrelation; improved multi-task learning; and the use of a prior-data-fitted model (TabPFN) for downstream in-context prediction. Our evaluations use a principled pairwise comparison framework that measures statistically significant performance differences. Across established Polaris benchmarks, Monroe matches or exceeds existing MFMs, while on activity cliff benchmarks, designed to assess utility for molecular discovery, it achieves significant improvements over prior methods. Finally, ablation and transfer experiments show that PFN-based downstream predictors also substantially improve two leading existing models, MiniMol and CheMeleon, yielding new state-of-the-art variants we call MiniMol_PFN and CheMeleon_PFN, suggesting that our downstream adaptation strategy generalizes beyond Monroe. Source code is at github.com/blazejba/monroe.
items.summary_zh: Monroe 是面向低数据生物测定预测的分子基础模型：在超过8,100万 PM6 分子上预训练，改进立体化学图表示、构象去噪和多任务训练，并以 TabPFN 进行上下文下游预测。在 Polaris 与 activity cliff 基准上，它达到或超过已有模型；其 PFN 下游策略也提升了 MiniMol 和 CheMeleon。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模量子化学预训练与统计显著性比较、消融和迁移实验共同构成较完整的模型证据，适合关注低数据药物发现。其结论目前仍来自基准任务和预印本，真实项目中的前瞻性命中率及计算成本值得继续观察。
items.abstract_zh: 由于药物发现数据集依赖耗时且昂贵的湿实验来生成数据并进行评估，生物测定活性预测常常受到数据不足的限制。这一挑战推动了近期对分子基础模型（MFMs）的研究；其目标是将通用化学知识编码为在数据受限情形下仍能良好泛化的分子表示。本文提出 Monroe，一种相对于现有最佳方法具有多项创新的新 MFM：规模扩大，可在来自 PM6 量子化学数据集的超过8,100万个分子上预训练；改进的立体化学图表示；包括构象去噪和嵌入去相关在内的改进训练损失；改进的多任务学习；以及使用先验数据拟合模型（TabPFN）进行下游上下文预测。我们的评估采用一种严谨的成对比较框架，用以衡量具有统计显著性的性能差异。在既有 Polaris 基准上，Monroe 达到或超过现有 MFM；而在旨在评估分子发现实用性的 activity cliff 基准上，它相对既有方法取得显著改进。最后，消融和迁移实验表明，基于 PFN 的下游预测器也大幅提升了两个领先既有模型 MiniMol 和 CheMeleon，形成我们称为 MiniMol_PFN 和 CheMeleon_PFN 的新最佳变体，说明我们的下游适配策略可泛化至 Monroe 之外。源代码见 github.com/blazejba/monroe。

items.title: Training Chemical Plausibility-Aware Large Language Models for Single-Step Retrosynthesis
items.abstract_or_text: Single-step retrosynthesis is a central component of computer-aided synthesis planning, yet its intrinsically one-to-many nature is poorly captured by single-answer evaluation and benchmarking protocols. To address this, we introduce Top-K prompting as a robust training and inference paradigm to better capture diverse, plausible reaction predictions. We compile CREED-CCV-2+USPTO-XL, an ultra-large-scale dataset of ~45.6 million verified reactions to train the C3LM (Chemistry Constraint-Consistent Language Model). By integrating fine-tuning with ChemCensor-based and novelty-oriented rewards, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on the OOD URSA-expert-2026 benchmark. Further analysis of reaction uniqueness shows that LLMs and conventional models explore complementary reaction spaces, motivating ensemble-based retrosynthesis systems. Overall, our results establish Top-K, plausibility-aware training as a practical new direction for robust future LLM-based synthesis planning.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以 Top-K 提示训练 C3LM，使单步逆合成可表达多个化学上合理的答案；模型在约4,560万条经验证反应组成的 CREED-CCV-2+USPTO-XL 上训练，并结合 ChemCensor 与新颖性奖励。在 OOD URSA-expert-2026 基准中报告了最佳表现，并分析了 LLM 与传统模型的互补反应空间。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它正面处理逆合成一对多属性，并采用超大规模反应集和分布外专家基准，方法设计具有明确化学指向性。仍应审视“合理性”和新颖性奖励的具体定义，以及基准表现能否转化为可执行的多步合成路线。
items.abstract_zh: 单步逆合成是计算机辅助合成规划的核心组成部分，但其内在的一对多性质未能被单答案评估和基准协议充分捕捉。为解决这一问题，我们引入 Top-K prompting，作为一种稳健的训练与推理范式，以更好地捕捉多样且合理的反应预测。我们汇编 CREED-CCV-2+USPTO-XL，这是一个由约4,560万条经验证反应组成的超大规模数据集，用于训练 C3LM（Chemistry Constraint-Consistent Language Model）。通过整合微调、基于 ChemCensor 的奖励和面向新颖性的奖励，我们的模型在 OOD URSA-expert-2026 基准上实现了最佳性能。对反应独特性的进一步分析显示，LLM 与传统模型探索了互补的反应空间，从而推动基于集成的逆合成系统。总体而言，我们的结果确立了 Top-K 和合理性感知训练作为未来稳健 LLM 逆合成规划的实用途径。
items.author_line: Bogdan Zagribelnyy, Ivan Ilin, Nikita Bondarev, Maksim Kuznetsov, Mathieu Reymond, Vladimir Aladinskiy, Alex Aliper, Alex Zhavoronkov

items.title: PandaDock: An Open-Source Molecular Docking Platform with Flexible-Ligand Search and Equivariant Neural Scoring
items.abstract_or_text: We present PandaDock, an open-source molecular docking platform implementing flexible-ligand conformational search with analytic gradients, a precomputed affinity grid engine, specialized modules for induced-fit, metal-coordination and tethered docking, and an SE(3)-equivariant graph neural network scoring function trained at scale. Ligand flexibility is represented as a torsion tree and pose parameters are optimized by Monte Carlo with Metropolis acceptance refined by L-BFGS, with rotational gradients obtained in closed form through the derivative of the SO(3) exponential map rather than by finite differences. Affinity grids are built by a blocked neighbor-selection scheme that is exact and 5.6-9.7x faster than dense evaluation, and may be cached across ligands sharing a receptor and site, reducing a six-ligand series from 29.3 s to 10.4 s. On 814 protein-ligand complexes spanning 14 target families, PandaDock recovers a pose within 2 Angstroms of the crystal geometry in 33.7% of cases at rank 1 and in 57.0% of cases within the returned ensemble. The GNN scoring function is trained on 741,706 co-folded complexes from SAIR under target-disjoint splits, reaching a Pearson r of 0.407 on 90,219 held-out complexes and transferring to 202 independent crystal structures with measured Ki, Kd, IC50 or EC50 at r = 0.467. We report the model against three controls, a target-mean predictor, a ligand-descriptor-only baseline, and within-target correlations, and document both where it performs and where it does not, including its unsuitability for pose rescoring. On an independent 30-compound series against a single GABAA receptor target, PandaDock's empirical scoring function ranks 8th of 25 methods evaluated, ahead of every AutoDock Vina and Vinardo configuration tested, while the GNN scores below Vina, consistent with the within-target ceiling identified on SAIR. At full scale on the PDBbind v2020 refined set (n = 4,640, native crystal poses), the fully independent SAIR model reaches r = 0.531, and a dedicated model trained on PDBbind alone under a target-disjoint split reaches r = 0.690 on its own held-out test complexes, the strongest evidence in this work that PandaDock's affinity predictions generalize. PandaDock is distributed under an open-source license at https://github.com/pritampanda15/PandaDock with a complete command-line interface and a reproducible benchmarking harness.
items.summary_zh: PandaDock 是开源分子对接平台，结合柔性配体搜索、预计算亲和力网格、诱导契合/金属配位/锚定对接模块和 SE(3) 等变 GNN 评分。作者在814个复合物、SAIR 目标隔离切分、独立晶体结构及30个化合物系列上报告姿势与亲和力评估，也明确指出其 GNN 不适合姿势重评分。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 开源实现、可复现基准和多层次独立测试使其具有实际工具价值；对失败模式的报告也提升了可信度。姿势首位成功率为33.7%，亲和力相关性在严格目标隔离设置下仍有限，使用时应与实验筛选或互补评分结合。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 PandaDock，一个开源分子对接平台，实施具有解析梯度的柔性配体构象搜索、预计算亲和力网格引擎、用于诱导契合、金属配位和锚定对接的专用模块，以及经过大规模训练的 SE(3) 等变图神经网络评分函数。配体柔性由扭转树表示，姿势参数通过带 Metropolis 接受的 Monte Carlo 优化，并由 L-BFGS 细化；旋转梯度通过 SO(3) 指数映射的导数以闭式形式获得，而非通过有限差分。亲和力网格由精确的分块邻居选择方案构建，比稠密计算快5.6–9.7倍，并可在共享受体和位点的配体之间缓存，使一个六配体系列的时间从29.3 s 降至10.4 s。在覆盖14个靶标家族的814个蛋白质–配体复合物上，PandaDock 在首位时有33.7%的案例恢复出距晶体几何2 Å以内的姿势，在返回的构象集合中该比例为57.0%。GNN 评分函数在 SAIR 的741,706个共折叠复合物上按靶标隔离切分训练，在90,219个留出复合物上达到 Pearson r = 0.407，并迁移至202个具有实测 Ki、Kd、IC50 或 EC50 的独立晶体结构，得到 r = 0.467。我们针对三个对照报告该模型：靶标均值预测器、仅配体描述符基线和靶标内相关性；并记录它的适用之处与不适用之处，包括其不适用于姿势重评分。在针对单一 GABAA 受体靶标的独立30化合物系列上，PandaDock 的经验评分函数在所评估的25种方法中排名第8，领先于每一种受测 AutoDock Vina 和 Vinardo 配置；GNN 评分低于 Vina，这与 SAIR 所揭示的靶标内上限一致。在完整规模的 PDBbind v2020 refined set（n = 4,640，原生晶体姿势）上，完全独立的 SAIR 模型达到 r = 0.531；而一个仅在 PDBbind 上按靶标隔离切分训练的专用模型，在其自身留出测试复合物上达到 r = 0.690，这是本工作中 PandaDock 亲和力预测能够泛化的最强证据。PandaDock 以开源许可证在 https://github.com/pritampanda15/PandaDock 发布，提供完整命令行界面和可复现的基准测试工具。

items.title: FRIE: Machine Learning Models for Interfragment Interaction Energies among Amino Acid Residues Based on Quantum Mechanical Data from FMODB
items.abstract_or_text: In recent years, quantum mechanical-based methods have offered superior accuracy for drug discovery; however, their high computational costs have limited their application in the late stages of molecular optimization. To overcome this efficiency bottleneck and enable rapid, large-scale structural biology assessments, in this study, we developed Fragment Regression Model for Interaction Energy (FRIE), a machine learning framework designed to predict interfragment interaction energies calculated using the fragment molecular orbital (FMO) method. This model focuses exclusively on interactions between amino acid residues within protein structures and establishes a robust baseline for macromolecular evaluation. Using the comprehensive FMO database named FMODB (https://drugdesign.riken.jp/FMODB/), we compiled a dataset comprising over 11 million amino acid residue pairs derived from 6,329 unique Protein Data Bank entries. Heavy atom distance matrices and formal charges were extracted as molecular explanatory descriptors to train and compare multiple machine learning algorithms. Among them, the Extra Trees Regressor model exhibited the highest predictive precision, achieving an average R 2 of 0.914 and an RMSE of 1.953 kcal/mol across 210 amino acid residue pairs. Furthermore, pair interaction energy decomposition analysis demonstrated that FRIE performed exceptionally well in predicting electrostatic interactions but encountered relatively greater difficulty with aromatic systems. Finally, external validation on AlphaFold2-predicted protein structures yielded high accuracy (R 2 ≥ 0.958), proving the model’s robustness and its potential for rapid evaluation of model structures, effectively bridging quantum chemical accuracy and computational efficiency.
items.summary_zh: FRIE 以 FMODB 中6,329个 PDB 条目、逾1,100万对氨基酸残基的 FMO 相互作用能训练机器学习模型。Extra Trees Regressor 在210类残基对上获得平均 R²=0.914、RMSE=1.953 kcal/mol，并在 AlphaFold2 预测结构外部测试中保持 R²≥0.958；其对芳香体系的预测较弱。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将量子力学片段分子轨道能量扩展为可大规模调用的蛋白结构评估指标，数据体量和外部验证都较有说服力。模型目前只覆盖氨基酸残基间相互作用，且芳香相互作用误差更大，不能直接替代完整的蛋白–配体量子化学计算。
items.abstract_zh: 近年来，基于量子力学的方法为药物发现提供了更高的准确性；然而，其高计算成本限制了其在分子优化后期的应用。为克服这一效率瓶颈并实现快速、大规模的结构生物学评估，本研究开发了片段相互作用能回归模型（FRIE），这是一个旨在预测由片段分子轨道（FMO）方法计算的片段间相互作用能的机器学习框架。该模型专注于蛋白质结构中氨基酸残基之间的相互作用，并为大分子评估建立了稳健基线。利用名为 FMODB（https://drugdesign.riken.jp/FMODB/）的综合 FMO 数据库，我们汇编了一个数据集，其中包含来自6,329个独特 Protein Data Bank 条目的超过1,100万对氨基酸残基。提取重原子距离矩阵和形式电荷作为分子解释描述符，用于训练和比较多种机器学习算法。其中，Extra Trees Regressor 模型显示出最高预测精度，在210类氨基酸残基对上取得平均 R² 为0.914、RMSE 为1.953 kcal/mol。进一步的对相互作用能分解分析表明，FRIE 在预测静电相互作用方面表现异常出色，但在芳香体系上遇到相对更大的困难。最后，对 AlphaFold2 预测蛋白质结构的外部验证获得高准确度（R² ≥ 0.958），证明该模型的稳健性及其快速评估模型结构的潜力，有效连接了量子化学准确性与计算效率。
items.author_line: Tomohiro Sato, Chiduru Watanabe, Yoshio Okiyama, Teruki Honma

items.title: Resolution-standardized evaluation of ligand atomic coordinates in crystallographic structures using machine learning
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate assessment of ligand coordinate-density consistency across different resolutions remains challenging in macromolecular crystallography. We introduce the atomic Box Correlation Coefficient (aBCC), an atom-level metric for evaluating the consistency between ligand atomic coordinates and electron density in a resolution-standardized framework. To predict aBCC values from electron-density maps, we developed QAEmap, a machine-learning model based on three-dimensional convolutional neural networks (3D-CNNs). The model was trained using Fourier-truncated electron-density maps and corresponding ligand coordinates generated from high-resolution structures in the Protein Data Bank. It was evaluated using both Fourier-truncated electron-density maps and experimentally determined PDB structures. was evaluated using both Fourier-truncated electron-density maps and experimentally determined PDB structures.The prediction accuracy gradually decreased with decreasing resolution, but remained reliable up to [~]3.5 [A]. These results demonstrate that aBCC enables resolution-standardized atom-wise evaluation of coordinate-density consistency across different resolutions and provide a foundation for further development and refinement of machine learning-based coordinate validation. SynopsisWe introduce the atomic box correlation coefficient (aBCC), a machine learning-based metric for the resolution-standardized atom-level evaluation of ligand coordinate-density consistency in crystallographic structures. aBCC provides a common framework for assessing and communicating the local coordinate reliability between structural biologists and researchers in structure-based drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: 该研究提出原子级 Box Correlation Coefficient（aBCC）及3D-CNN 模型 QAEmap，用统一分辨率尺度衡量蛋白晶体结构中配体坐标与电子密度的一致性。模型由高分辨率 PDB 结构生成的傅里叶截断密度图训练，并在模拟截断图和实验 PDB 结构上测试，在约3.5 Å以内保持可靠预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它瞄准结构导向药物发现常被忽略的配体局部坐标质量问题，可帮助更谨慎地解释结合模式。分辨率降低时准确性下降，且证据主要是结构数据评估；在不同实验室和难解析配体上的实用性仍需扩大验证。
items.abstract_zh: 在大分子晶体学中，跨不同分辨率准确评估配体坐标–密度一致性仍具挑战。我们引入原子 Box Correlation Coefficient（aBCC），这是一种在分辨率标准化框架中评估配体原子坐标与电子密度一致性的原子级指标。为从电子密度图预测 aBCC 值，我们开发了 QAEmap，这是一种基于三维卷积神经网络（3D-CNNs）的机器学习模型。该模型使用由 Protein Data Bank 高分辨率结构生成的傅里叶截断电子密度图及相应配体坐标进行训练。它同时使用傅里叶截断电子密度图和实验确定的 PDB 结构进行评估。它同时使用傅里叶截断电子密度图和实验确定的 PDB 结构进行评估。预测准确度随分辨率降低而逐渐下降，但在约3.5 Å以内仍保持可靠。这些结果表明，aBCC 可实现跨不同分辨率的、经分辨率标准化的逐原子坐标–密度一致性评估，并为机器学习坐标验证的进一步开发和完善奠定基础。概要：我们引入原子 box correlation coefficient（aBCC），一种基于机器学习的指标，用于在晶体学结构中以分辨率标准化方式逐原子评估配体坐标–密度一致性。aBCC 为评估和交流局部坐标可靠性提供共同框架，服务于结构生物学家和结构导向药物发现研究者。
items.author_line: Miyaguchi, I., Hata, H., Kuribayashi, T., Takahashi, S., Kashima, A., Murasaki, K., Matsumoto, S., Terayama, K., Ohta, M., Ikeguchi, M.

items.title: Domain-Adapted Molecular Language Models for Efficient Search of Make-on-Demand Libraries
items.abstract_or_text: Pretrained molecular language models are increasingly used as molecular encoders for learning structure-property relationships. However, their practical suitability for molecular discovery within and beyond their pretraining domain remains unclear. Herein, we systematically benchmark four molecular language models across six virtual molecular libraries spanning drug discovery, organic materials, and catalysis. Native molecular language model embeddings show substantial variation in discovery performance across libraries, whereas molecular fingerprints provide a consistently strong and robust baseline. Consistent with a potential domain-representation mismatch, we show that explicit domain adaptation substantially improves representation performance. Fine-tuning molecular language model encoders on structures from the target virtual library consistently improves sample efficiency, with several adapted encoders emerging as the top-performing representations across the benchmark tasks. These results show that molecular representation quality depends strongly on the target domain and that explicit adaptation can improve the practical utility of molecular foundation models. More broadly, our findings establish domain-adapted molecular representations as a promising strategy for sample-efficient adaptive decision making in virtual screening and self-driving laboratories.
items.summary_zh: 该研究在药物、材料和催化共6个虚拟分子库上系统比较4种分子语言模型。原生嵌入的发现性能随领域大幅变化，而针对目标库结构进行微调可稳定提高样本效率，并在多项任务中获得最佳表示。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文为“预训练分子表示可直接通用”的常见假设提供了跨领域的反例，并给出可操作的领域适配路线，适用于虚拟筛选与自驱实验室。结果仍依赖所选虚拟库和表征任务，微调所需数据量及对真正未知化学空间的外推范围值得审查。
items.abstract_zh: 预训练分子语言模型正日益被用作学习结构–性质关系的分子编码器。然而，其在预训练领域内外用于分子发现的实际适用性仍不清楚。本文系统地在横跨药物发现、有机材料和催化的6个虚拟分子库中对4种分子语言模型进行基准测试。原生分子语言模型嵌入在不同分子库中的发现性能变化很大，而分子指纹提供了始终强劲且稳健的基线。与潜在的领域–表示不匹配一致，我们显示显式领域适配可大幅改善表示性能。在目标虚拟库的结构上微调分子语言模型编码器，可始终提高样本效率；若干适配后的编码器在基准任务中成为表现最佳的表示。这些结果显示，分子表示质量强烈依赖目标领域，显式适配可提高分子基础模型的实际效用。更广泛地说，我们的发现确立了领域适配分子表示作为虚拟筛选和自驱实验室中实现高样本效率自适应决策的有前景策略。
items.author_line: Henrik Wille, Luis-Finley Schütz, Felix Strieth-Kalthoff

items.title: Leveraging generative hallucination and biophysics-informed modeling for unified biomolecular sequence-structure co-design
items.abstract_or_text: Biomolecular design underpins applications from molecular recognition to therapeutics and synthetic biology, yet de novo interaction design remains challenging-especially for DNA/RNA, underexplored non-protein modalities with scarce, heterogeneous complex data and sharper geometric and chemical constraints. We introduce MCTH (Monte Carlo Tree Hallucination), an inference-only framework that casts all-atom sequence-structure co-design as uncertainty-aware planning over hallucinated states from pretrained folding and inverse-folding models, with optional biophysical control within the same decision loop. MCTH treats these models as frozen black-box operators and uses Monte Carlo Tree Search to allocate a fixed inference budget across competing design trajectories, incorporating model confidence and uncertainty, as well as cross-expert consensus/disagreement when multiple predictors are available. Across protein-RNA, protein-DNA, protein-protein, and protein-ligand design, matched-budget experiments show that adaptive search improves over simpler sampling and cycling strategies, while held-out AlphaFold3 and Chai-1 evaluations demonstrate transfer beyond the search-time oracle. MCTH provides a shared planning layer across modalities while allowing task-specific folding, inverse-folding, and biophysical modules, requiring no fine-tuning or backpropagation through component models.
items.summary_zh: MCTH 用 Monte Carlo Tree Search 在冻结的折叠与逆折叠模型生成状态之间分配推理预算，实现蛋白–RNA、蛋白–DNA、蛋白–蛋白及蛋白–配体的全原子序列–结构协同设计。匹配预算实验优于简单采样和循环策略，并通过未参与搜索的 AlphaFold3 与 Chai-1 评估显示迁移性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将不确定性、模型间共识和生物物理约束纳入同一设计搜索过程，并覆盖多种生物分子相互作用类型。验证仍以预测器评估为主；生成构象的实验结构和功能验证将决定其真实设计价值。
items.abstract_zh: 生物分子设计支撑着从分子识别到治疗学和合成生物学的应用，但从头相互作用设计仍具挑战，尤其是 DNA/RNA：这些尚未被充分探索的非蛋白质模态具有稀缺、异质的复合物数据以及更严格的几何和化学约束。我们引入 MCTH（Monte Carlo Tree Hallucination），一种仅推理框架，它将全原子序列–结构协同设计表述为在预训练折叠和逆折叠模型产生的幻觉状态上进行不确定性感知规划，并可在同一决策循环中加入可选生物物理控制。MCTH 将这些模型视为冻结的黑箱算子，并使用 Monte Carlo Tree Search 在相互竞争的设计轨迹之间分配固定推理预算，整合模型置信度和不确定性，以及在可用多个预测器时的跨专家共识/分歧。在蛋白–RNA、蛋白–DNA、蛋白–蛋白和蛋白–配体设计中，匹配预算实验显示，自适应搜索优于更简单的采样和循环策略；而留出的 AlphaFold3 和 Chai-1 评估证明了超越搜索时预言器的迁移能力。MCTH 在模态间提供共享规划层，同时允许采用任务专用的折叠、逆折叠和生物物理模块，不需要微调或通过组件模型进行反向传播。
items.author_line: Xuefeng Liu, Mingxuan Cao, Xiao Luo, Songhao Jiang, Tobin Sosnick, Jinbo Xu, Louis Maher, Rick Stevens

items.title: Chemical Similarity-Informed Machine Learning for Navigating Multi-Component Polymeric Material Design Space
items.abstract_or_text: Chemical representation remains a central obstacle to applying machine learning (ML) in polymer science, and the difficulty compounds in multi-component formulations, where each polymer, solvent, and additive must be featurized independently and the inter-component interactions that often govern material properties go unencoded. Here we introduce a similarityinformed ML framework that, instead of encoding explicit chemical structures, represents each system by the pairwise chemical similarity between its components and uses these scalars as training features. Because it depends on relative similarity rather than on specific structural features, the representation is low-dimensional and inherently chemistry-agnostic. We validate the framework on block copolymer (BCP) thin films processed by non-volatile additive solvent annealing (NVASA) and blending, using high-throughput GISAXS analysis to assemble a dataset of over 700 nanoscale morphology measurements. Collapsing thousands of structural features into only 49 similarity descriptors, the framework matches the accuracy of the state-of-the-art full-feature and deep-learning baselines, with test R2 values of 0.986 for domain spacing and 0.835 for FWHM, while training in minutes rather than hours and yielding interpretability at the level of component pairs through SHAP analysis. An uncertainty-based active learning strategy reaches comparable accuracy using only 11% of the training data. Most importantly, the framework generalizes to 10 BCP thin films built from 5 previously unseen polymers and 2 unseen solvents (validation R2 of 0.928 for domain spacing) and transfers to an independent polymer solubility classification task, where it outperforms a Morgan-fingerprint benchmark on unseen chemistries. Together, these results establish a computationally efficient, interpretable, and generalizable representation of polymer chemistry for ML, enabling rapid exploration of vast chemical and processing spaces.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以组分间成对化学相似度替代显式结构特征，建立多组分聚合物材料的低维、可解释机器学习表示。在含700余个 GISAXS 形貌测量的数据集上，它以49个描述符达到强基线精度，并以11%的训练数据完成主动学习；对未见聚合物和溶剂及独立溶解度任务也展示了迁移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对于配方复杂、数据有限的聚合物体系，这种表示兼具较低训练成本、解释性和外部化学泛化测试，具有直接的材料设计价值。其成功目前基于特定 BCP 薄膜加工场景，相似度度量选择及向更多性质、加工条件的迁移仍需检验。
items.abstract_zh: 化学表示仍是将机器学习（ML）应用于聚合物科学的核心障碍；在多组分配方中，这一困难进一步加剧，因为每种聚合物、溶剂和添加剂都必须独立特征化，而常常决定材料性质的组分间相互作用并未被编码。本文引入一种相似度知情的 ML 框架；它不编码显式化学结构，而是以各组分之间的成对化学相似度来表示每个体系，并将这些标量用作训练特征。由于依赖相对相似度而非特定结构特征，该表示是低维的，并且天然不依赖于特定化学。我们在经非挥发性添加剂溶剂退火（NVASA）和共混处理的嵌段共聚物（BCP）薄膜上验证该框架，利用高通量 GISAXS 分析建立了一个包含700余项纳米尺度形貌测量的数据集。该框架将数千个结构特征压缩为仅49个相似度描述符，在域间距上获得测试 R² 为0.986、在 FWHM 上获得0.835，与最佳全特征和深度学习基线的准确度相当；训练仅需数分钟而非数小时，并通过 SHAP 分析在组分对层面提供可解释性。一种基于不确定性的主动学习策略仅用11%的训练数据便达到可比准确度。最重要的是，该框架可泛化至由5种此前未见聚合物和2种未见溶剂构成的10种 BCP 薄膜（域间距验证 R² 为0.928），并迁移至独立的聚合物溶解度分类任务，在未见化学体系上优于 Morgan-fingerprint 基准。总体而言，这些结果确立了一种计算高效、可解释且可泛化的聚合物化学 ML 表示，可实现对巨大化学和加工空间的快速探索。
items.author_line: Bradley Lamb, Sri Vishnuvardhan Reddy Akepati, Saroj Upreti, Xiaodan Gu, Boran Ma

items.title: Local Symmetry Breaking and Correlated Fluctuations in Quantum Materials from Atomistic Foundation Models
items.abstract_or_text: Short-range structural distortions retained within nominally high-symmetry crystals underlie the anomalous physical properties of many advanced materials. These distortions reflect local symmetry breaking and correlated fluctuations extending over nanometer length scales and picosecond timescales, making their accurate modeling challenging. Here, we demonstrate that such distortions can be modeled using a machine learning-based framework, taking RuP, the parent compound of ruthenium-pnictide superconductors, as a representative quantum material. By fine-tuning an atomistic foundation model on ab initio molecular dynamics data, we obtain an interatomic potential that captures the temperature-dependent structural evolution of RuP. The simulations reveal a two-stage phase transition, with local monoclinic distortions persisting within the average high-symmetry phase well above the transition, indicating local symmetry breaking and correlated fluctuations. Electronic-structure calculations and phonon analysis connect these distortions to the evolution of the electronic state and the dynamical instability of the high-symmetry phase. Our results establish fine-tuned atomistic foundation models as a practical route for resolving short-range structural distortions in materials with complex phase behavior.
items.summary_zh: 作者以 RuP 为代表量子材料，在 ab initio 分子动力学数据上微调原子基础模型，得到可再现温度依赖结构演化的原子间势。模拟揭示局部单斜畸变可在平均高对称相中持续存在，并与电子结构演化和声子动力学不稳定性相联系。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究展示基础模型如何以接近原子模拟的方式研究纳米尺度、皮秒尺度的局域对称性破缺，对复杂相变材料研究很有吸引力。证据聚焦 RuP 单一代表体系，势函数在相图其他区域及不同材料家族中的可靠程度仍需独立验证。
items.abstract_zh: 在名义上高对称晶体中保留的短程结构畸变，是许多先进材料异常物理性质的基础。这些畸变反映了局域对称性破缺和延伸至纳米长度尺度、皮秒时间尺度的关联涨落，使其准确建模颇具挑战。本文以钌磷化物超导体的母体化合物 RuP 为代表量子材料，展示可使用基于机器学习的框架对此类畸变进行建模。通过在 ab initio 分子动力学数据上微调原子基础模型，我们获得了一个能捕捉 RuP 温度依赖结构演化的原子间势。模拟揭示两阶段相变：局部单斜畸变在转变温度以上、平均高对称相中仍持续存在，表明存在局域对称性破缺和关联涨落。电子结构计算和声子分析将这些畸变与电子态演化及高对称相的动力学不稳定性联系起来。我们的结果确立了经微调的原子基础模型作为解析具有复杂相行为材料中短程结构畸变的实用途径。
items.author_line: Ouail Zakary, Weiguo Yin, Niraj Aryal

items.title: Single-Molecule Proteomics via a Dynamic Translocase and Physics-Informed Machine Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Single-molecule protein sequencing promises to democratize clinical proteomics, but platforms retrofitting static DNA-sequencing nanopores face a fundamental biophysical bottleneck: they only measure one-dimensional excluded volume. Consequently, these static calipers struggle to resolve isobaric residues, requiring complex DNA-handle chemistries and target concentrations that exceed clinically relevant abundance ranges. Here, we introduce a dynamical, target-docking translocase engine--the anthrax toxin protective antigen (PA)--as a label-free single-molecule peptide sensor. By extracting the multi-state thermodynamic friction generated as the pore's active site dynamically "breathes" around translocating analytes, we trained a physics-informed machine learning (PIML) architecture to classify a 20-member guest-host peptide library panel representing all 20 canonical amino acids at the single-event level. Operating at low nanomolar concentrations under a 35-millisecond thermodynamic read constraint, the translocase resolved isobaric variants (leucine and isoleucine). Furthermore, we achieved 98.02 (+/-0.05)% classification accuracy on a panel of five un-tagged, native clinical biomarkers (e.g., KRAS G12D, angiotensin, bradykinin). Transitioning from static volumetric measurement to time-domain thermodynamic fingerprinting establishes the requisite protein nanopore hardware for de novo proteomics.
items.summary_zh: 该工作用炭疽毒素保护性抗原（PA）构建动态靶标对接转位酶单分子肽传感器，并用物理知情机器学习从时间域热力学摩擦指纹识别肽。它在低纳摩尔浓度、35 ms 读出条件下区分 leucine/isoleucine，并在5种未标记临床生物标志物上报告98.02（±0.05）%分类准确率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 动态转位机制与 PIML 的结合为无标记单分子蛋白质组学提供了有实验支撑的新测量范式，也回应了静态纳米孔的异质量残基难题。当前测试库规模较小，临床复杂样本中的通量、误判率和完整蛋白序列覆盖仍是关键问题。
items.abstract_zh: 单分子蛋白质测序有望普及临床蛋白质组学，但对静态 DNA 测序纳米孔进行改造的平台面临根本生物物理瓶颈：它们只能测量一维排除体积。因此，这些静态卡尺难以分辨等质量残基，需要复杂的 DNA 把手化学以及高于临床相关丰度范围的靶标浓度。本文引入一种动态靶标对接转位酶引擎——炭疽毒素保护性抗原（PA）——作为无标记单分子肽传感器。通过提取孔活性位点在转运分析物周围动态“呼吸”时产生的多状态热力学摩擦，我们训练了物理知情机器学习（PIML）架构，在单事件层面分类一个代表全部20种标准氨基酸的20成员客体–主体肽文库面板。在低纳摩尔浓度和35毫秒热力学读出约束下运行时，该转位酶区分了等质量变体（leucine 和 isoleucine）。此外，我们在5种未加标签的天然临床生物标志物面板（例如 KRAS G12D、angiotensin、bradykinin）上实现98.02（±0.05）%的分类准确率。从静态体积测量转向时间域热力学指纹，建立了从头蛋白质组学所需的蛋白质纳米孔硬件。
items.author_line: Taylor, J. E., Sharma, P., Krantz, B.

items.title: Multitask Bayesian Neural Networks for Multiparameter Protein Engineering
items.abstract_or_text: Simultaneously engineering multiple protein properties remains a major challenge. Existing machine learning-based pipelines for protein engineering often model properties separately, failing to capture their dependencies and trade-offs. Here, we systematically evaluate how Bayesian parameterization on Multitask Neural Networks can enable robust simultaneous protein engineering under scarce, noisy experimental data. We curated a comprehensive set of 27 multiparameter protein datasets. Then, we compared three algorithm architectures spanning low to full Bayesian parameterization across 16 sequence representations and dimensionality reduction (2,592 models). Bayesian Last Layer models delivered the strongest overall accuracy, generalization, and calibration, ranking as the top-performing model on 70% of benchmark datasets. Dimensionality reduction improved predictive performance by up to 42% and enhanced calibration up to 57% across architectures. Notably, simple One-Hot encoding achieved top performance on 25% of benchmark datasets, particularly with larger datasets. These results establish practical design principles for reliable and data-efficient multiparameter protein engineering.
items.summary_zh: 该研究汇集27个多参数蛋白数据集，系统比较不同 Bayesian 参数化程度、16种序列表征和降维策略，共评估2,592个模型。Bayesian Last Layer 在70%的基准数据集上居首；降维可将预测性能提高至42%、校准性提高至57%，而 One-Hot 在较大数据集上仍具竞争力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文以大规模系统比较而非单一模型展示多目标蛋白工程的稳健设计原则，尤其关注数据稀缺和噪声情形。基准提升未必等同于实验迭代中的成功率，任务间数据泄漏控制及实际突变库验证值得继续关注。
items.abstract_zh: 同时工程化多种蛋白质性质仍是一项重大挑战。现有基于机器学习的蛋白质工程流程常常分别建模各项性质，未能捕捉它们的依赖关系和权衡。本文系统评估多任务神经网络上的 Bayesian 参数化如何在稀缺、带噪实验数据下实现稳健的同步蛋白质工程。我们整理了一套全面的27个多参数蛋白质数据集。随后，我们比较了横跨低度至完全 Bayesian 参数化的三种算法架构、16种序列表征和降维方法（共2,592个模型）。Bayesian Last Layer 模型提供了最强的总体准确度、泛化能力和校准性，在70%的基准数据集中位列最佳模型。降维使各架构的预测性能最高提高42%，校准性最高提高57%。值得注意的是，简单的 One-Hot 编码在25%的基准数据集中取得最佳性能，尤其是在较大数据集上。这些结果确立了可靠且数据高效的多参数蛋白质工程实用设计原则。
items.author_line: Fabio Herrera-Rocha, David Medina-Ortiz, Desiree Wyrzykala, Tharun Srinivasan Sudha, Mehdi D. Davari

items.title: Enhancing EBSD throughput of battery electrode materials using super-resolution generative adversarial networks
items.abstract_or_text: Quantitative microstructural characterization of Li-ion battery electrode materials using electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) has been proven as a critical method for optimizing cell performance. However, the inherently slow nature of EBSD can hinder the throughput of analyses needed for statistical representation of a material microstructure being developed. This work demonstrates a machine learning super-resolution framework using a generative adversarial network (SRGAN) to significantly increase EBSD throughput. The SRGAN model was trained on EBSD data of LiNixMnyCozO2 (NMC) cathode particles to computationally enhance low-resolution datasets and its performance is compared against classical interpolation methods across various upscaling factors (2x to 12x). Both qualitative image metrics and quantitative microstructural analysis verified that the SRGAN systematically outperformed classical methods, particularly in preserving small grains and maintaining realistic grain boundaries. We demonstrate that a 5x upscaling factor, corresponding to a 25x speed-up in acquisition time or a 25x larger field of view, is practical while maintaining acceptable accuracy in key metrics like grain size and shape. For instance, at 5x upscaling, relative errors were +5.7%, +8.2%, and -14.6% on grain area-equivalent diameter, grain maximum sphere-inscribed diameter, and grain boundary length, respectively. The SRGAN methodology developed in this work significantly enhances the efficiency of EBSD acquisition for more statistically robust microstructural dataset, enabling EBSD as a high-throughput characterization tool for materials research and industrial process development.
items.summary_zh: 研究以 LiNixMnyCozO2（NMC）正极 EBSD 数据训练 SRGAN，对低分辨率表征进行超分辨重建。在2×至12×放大比较中，SRGAN 比经典插值更能保留细小晶粒和真实晶界；5×放大可使采集速度提高25倍，并给出粒径、形状和晶界长度的定量误差。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把生成模型用于电池材料显微结构表征吞吐量瓶颈，并以图像与材料统计指标共同验证，具有明确的实验流程意义。放大重建可能掩盖罕见缺陷或引入伪结构，模型跨不同电极化学组成、仪器和制样条件的稳定性尚需验证。
items.abstract_zh: 使用电子背散射衍射（EBSD）对锂离子电池电极材料进行定量微结构表征，已被证明是优化电池性能的关键方法。然而，EBSD 固有的缓慢特性会阻碍获得材料微结构统计代表性所需分析的吞吐量。本工作展示一种使用生成对抗网络（SRGAN）的机器学习超分辨框架，可显著提高 EBSD 吞吐量。SRGAN 模型在 LiNixMnyCozO2（NMC）正极颗粒的 EBSD 数据上训练，以计算方式增强低分辨率数据集；其性能在各种放大倍数（2×至12×）下与经典插值方法比较。定性图像指标和定量微结构分析均证实，SRGAN 系统性优于经典方法，尤其在保留小晶粒和维持真实晶界方面。我们表明，5×放大倍数是实用的，相当于采集时间加快25倍或视野扩大25倍，同时在晶粒尺寸和形状等关键指标上保持可接受的准确度。例如，在5×放大时，晶粒面积等效直径、晶粒最大内接球直径和晶界长度的相对误差分别为+5.7%、+8.2%和-14.6%。本工作开发的 SRGAN 方法显著提升 EBSD 采集效率，以获得统计上更稳健的微结构数据集，使 EBSD 成为材料研究和工业过程开发中的高通量表征工具。
items.author_line: John Mangum, Andrew Glaws, Francois Usseglio-Viretta, Steven Spurgeon, Donal Finegan

items.title: Mechanistic Dissection of Entropic Penalty upon Ligand Binding and Molecular Flexibility via Molecular Dynamics Simulations and Machine Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular flexibility governs how molecules behave, reorganize, and respond to their environment. Although experiments measure molar entropy for small molecules and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations capture molecular motions, quantifying configuration entropy and the concerted internal motions such as torsion rotations, angle bending, and their couplings are central to understanding thermodynamic behavior but remains challenging. To dissect these contributions, we used MD trajectories and developed an internal coordinate PC-entropy (iPC-entropy) method to probe the origins of entropy and reveal how specific motions shape the thermodynamic landscape. The studies accurately captured molar entropy, identified key torsional motions as major contributors, and uncovered a critical angle-torsion coupling in which angle bending was strongly correlated with torsional rotation, a coupling that increases nonlinearly with molecular size. Evaluating entropic changes upon protein-ligand binding reveals that dominant entropic penalty arises from ligand dihedral rigidification rather than protein reorganization and highlights the specific dihedral rotations that become restricted. We also suggest systematic corrections for approaches considering solely rotamers to reliably reproduce the relative entropic penalty in computer-aided drug discovery. Together, our findings elucidate the molecular origins of entropy and entropy changes. In addition, we can quantify and illustrate the internal motions that strongly shape binding thermodynamics, thereby offering mechanistic insights to guide drug development.
items.summary_zh: 作者从分子动力学轨迹构建内部坐标 PC-entropy（iPC-entropy）方法，分解扭转、键角及其耦合对构型熵的贡献。蛋白–配体结合分析显示，主要熵罚来自配体二面角刚化而非蛋白重组，并指出了受限的具体二面角旋转。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结合熵是结构导向设计中难以量化的因素；该方法提供可解释的运动学来源，可用于改进配体优化假设。摘要虽称能准确捕捉摩尔熵，但缺少跨体系误差和实验对照细节，结论的普适性仍待全文证据支持。
items.abstract_zh: 分子柔性决定分子如何表现、重组并响应其环境。尽管实验测量小分子的摩尔熵，分子动力学（MD）模拟捕捉分子运动，但量化构型熵以及扭转旋转、键角弯曲及其耦合等协同内部运动，是理解热力学行为的核心，却仍具挑战。为剖析这些贡献，我们使用 MD 轨迹并开发内部坐标 PC-entropy（iPC-entropy）方法，以探究熵的来源并揭示特定运动如何塑造热力学图景。研究准确捕捉了摩尔熵，识别出关键扭转运动是主要贡献者，并发现关键的键角–扭转耦合：键角弯曲与扭转旋转强相关，且该耦合随分子尺寸非线性增加。评估蛋白质–配体结合时的熵变化显示，主导性熵罚来自配体二面角刚化，而非蛋白质重组，并突出了受到限制的具体二面角旋转。我们还为仅考虑 rotamer 的方法提出系统性校正，以便在计算机辅助药物发现中可靠再现相对熵罚。总体而言，我们的发现阐明了熵和熵变化的分子起源。此外，我们能够量化并展示强烈塑造结合热力学的内部运动，从而提供指导药物开发的机制性见解。
items.author_line: Hung, T. I., Vig, E., Chang, C.-e.

items.title: An AI System for Autonomous Algorithm Evolution in Drug Development
items.abstract_or_text: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly permeating the drug development pipeline. Numerous algorithms for accelerating this multi-stage and multi-task process have been constructed, which depends heavily on expert design and labor-intensive task-specific optimization. Given that AI-driven acceleration of drug development is recognized as a cumulative, often synergistic, effect across multiple stages, the autonomous evolution of existing algorithms across the entire pipeline is demanded to achieve a holistic advancement. Here, we present DrugEvolve, a multi-role large language model system for systematic and autonomous algorithm evolution in drug development. DrugEvolve realizes a closed-loop evolution process by incorporating Researcher, Engineer, and Analyst domains, and enables an iterative design, implementation, evaluation, and refinement of algorithm by leveraging scientific knowledge and accumulated evolutionary experience. Across eleven representative tasks spanning target identification, drug discovery, preclinical study, and clinical trial, DrugEvolve autonomously evolved the corresponding task-specific algorithms and achieved substantial performance enhancement on 120 benchmark test sets. Moreover, it showed robust generalizabilities across heterogeneous data modalities (ranging from biological sequence and graph to molecular topology and textual language), and realized gains in both predictive and generative tasks. Collectively, this AI system can serve not only as an algorithmic infrastructure for drug development, but also as a transferable paradigm for broader scientific domains.
items.summary_zh: DrugEvolve 是由 Researcher、Engineer 和 Analyst 角色组成的 LLM 系统，自动迭代设计、实现、评估并优化药物开发算法。在靶点识别、药物发现、临床前研究和临床试验的11类任务、120个基准测试集上，作者报告任务特异算法的显著提升，并覆盖预测和生成任务。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究试图把药物研发各阶段的算法改进作为可迁移的自动化研究过程，并给出多模态、大范围基准。系统复杂且基准覆盖广，因果归因、可复现代码、计算资源以及对新任务的独立前瞻检验都需仔细审阅。
items.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）正日益渗透药物开发流程。为加速这一多阶段、多任务过程已构建了众多算法，但它们高度依赖专家设计和劳动密集型的任务专用优化。鉴于 AI 驱动的药物开发加速被认为是在多个阶段累积、且往往协同产生的效果，因此需要对整个流程中现有算法进行自主演化，以实现整体性进步。本文提出 DrugEvolve，一种用于药物开发中系统化、自主算法演化的多角色大语言模型系统。DrugEvolve 纳入 Researcher、Engineer 和 Analyst 领域，实现反复的算法设计、实现、评估和改进过程，借助科学知识和累积的演化经验。在横跨靶点识别、药物发现、临床前研究和临床试验的11项代表性任务中，DrugEvolve 自主演化了相应的任务专用算法，并在120个基准测试集上实现显著性能增强。此外，它在异质数据模态间表现出稳健泛化能力（从生物序列和图到分子拓扑和文本语言），并在预测任务和生成任务中均取得增益。总之，该 AI 系统不仅可作为药物开发的算法基础设施，也可作为更广泛科学领域的可迁移范式。
items.author_line: Zhou, Z., Nan, Y., Mou, M., Qian, Y., Liu, Y., Zuo, Z., Yang, H., Xu, W., Li, B., Jiang, W., Ren, Y., Liao, Y., Wang, Y., Li, Y., Yang, Q., Xi, Z., Mi, T., Sun, H., Liu, P., Zhu, F.

items.title: BEAVER: A Multi-Agent Framework for Evidence-Grounded Answering and Property-Constrained Design of Degradable Polymers
items.abstract_or_text: Degradable polymers are an important research area in materials science because of their environmental compatibility and tunable degradation. Scientific agents could accelerate discovery by integrating fragmented literature with heterogeneous property data, but two challenges remain: retrieving relevant evidence with sufficient coverage and converting it into traceable reasoning and multi-property-constrained material design. Here, we present BEAVER, an evidence-grounded multi-agent framework for scientific question answering and degradable polymer design. Its Intent-Planner architecture coordinates hybrid retrieval-augmented generation in two workflows: Query Mode for evidence-grounded question answering and Design Mode for candidate generation and assessment under property constraints. Across retrieval, question-answering, and design benchmarks, BEAVER translated higher-quality evidence into more reliable outputs. Reranking increased the overall RAGAS score by more than 0.08 on average across the chunk-level retrieval settings, while the reranked chunk-level hybrid configuration achieved the best balance between recall and relevance. In question answering, BEAVER obtained a bidirectional mean Overall score of 8.77, compared with 8.42 for the strongest closed-book baseline. In coupled-property design, it performed comparably to representative frontier LLMs while providing clearer evidence traceability, more complete constraint handling, and more explicit analysis of risks and uncertainties. Overall, BEAVER offers a traceable and extensible framework that unifies hybrid retrieval, evidence-grounded reasoning, and property-constrained design for degradable polymer research.
items.summary_zh: BEAVER 是面向可降解聚合物的证据驱动多智能体系统，提供混合检索增强问答和多性质约束设计两种工作模式。作者报告重排序使 RAGAS 平均总分提高逾0.08，问答总体得分为8.77，并在耦合性质设计中提供更清晰的证据追溯和约束处理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 可降解聚合物研究常受文献与性质数据割裂影响，该系统将检索、推理和设计放入可追溯工作流，具备实用价值。问答分数和候选设计质量仍依赖基准及评估协议，生成材料的合成、降解和性能实验尚未由摘要证实。
items.abstract_zh: 可降解聚合物因其环境相容性和可调降解性而成为材料科学的重要研究领域。科学智能体可通过整合碎片化文献与异质性质数据加速发现，但仍存在两项挑战：以足够覆盖度检索相关证据，以及将其转化为可追溯推理和多性质约束材料设计。本文提出 BEAVER，一种用于科学问答和可降解聚合物设计的证据驱动多智能体框架。其 Intent-Planner 架构在两种工作流中协调混合检索增强生成：用于证据驱动问答的 Query Mode，以及用于在性质约束下进行候选生成和评估的 Design Mode。在检索、问答和设计基准中，BEAVER 将更高质量的证据转化为更可靠的输出。在块级检索设置中，重排序使平均总体 RAGAS 分数提高逾0.08；经重排序的块级混合配置在召回率与相关性之间取得最佳平衡。在问答中，BEAVER 获得双向平均 Overall 分数8.77，而最强闭卷基线为8.42。在耦合性质设计中，它的表现可与代表性前沿 LLM 相比，同时提供更清晰的证据追溯、更完整的约束处理，以及对风险和不确定性更明确的分析。总体而言，BEAVER 提供了一个可追溯、可扩展的框架，统一混合检索、证据驱动推理和面向可降解聚合物研究的性质约束设计。
items.author_line: Xuerui Fang, Boyuan Zhang, Meifang Zhu, Jin Wen

review.note: 共选入16项。均为预印本；技术指标、基准结果与实验结论目前主要来自作者公开摘要，仍需等待全文方法细节、数据可得性与同行评议进一步检验。
